name: Selenium Test Automation
certifications: No official Selenium certification; assessed by capstone project
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering

beginner.summary: For manual testers and new automation engineers. Covers the Java needed for Selenium, WebDriver set-up, locators, interacting with every common element, waits, alerts, frames and windows, TestNG, assertions, data-driven tests with Excel, a first Page Object Model and HTML reports, ending with an automated regression suite for a web shop.
prerequisites: Has done manual testing of web applications
Basic programming knowledge helps but is not required
Can install software on their machine
outcomes: Write Java code needed for test automation
Automate web pages with Selenium WebDriver using reliable locators and waits
Organise tests with TestNG, data-driven tests and page objects
Run suites and produce readable reports

days.topic: Selenium Overview and Environment Setup
subtopics: What Selenium is: WebDriver, IDE and Grid
Selenium compared with Playwright and Cypress
Installing Java 21, Maven and IntelliJ IDEA
Opening a browser and a page
days.lab_task: Set up a Maven project with Selenium and TestNG, write a test that opens the course web shop in Chrome and Firefox, checks the page title and closes the browser.
days.deliverable: Maven project and test run output
checks: No browser windows left after the run

days.topic: Java Essentials for Testers: Variables, Conditions and Loops
days.lab_task: Write small Java programs that validate test data: check email formats, loop over a list of prices to find the highest and count words in a product description.
days.deliverable: Java programs with output
checks: Valid and invalid emails reported correctly

days.topic: Java for Automation: Methods, Classes, Collections and Exceptions
days.lab_task: Model a product and a cart as classes, store products in an ArrayList and a HashMap, calculate totals and handle an invalid quantity with an exception.
days.deliverable: Java classes with a test program
checks: Exception caught with a clear message
Look up a product by code

days.topic: WebDriver Navigation and Browser Commands
days.lab_task: Write tests that navigate between shop pages, check titles and URLs, use back and forward, run in headless mode and set a fixed window size.
days.deliverable: Navigation tests and run output
checks: Navigate back after opening a product
Returns to the list page URL
Tests pass without a visible browser

days.topic: Locators: ID, Name, Class, Link Text and CSS Selectors
subtopics: Link text and partial link text
days.lab_task: Locate 20 elements on the shop pages with ID, name, class, link text and CSS selectors, check each in DevTools first and replace three fragile locators with stable ones.
days.deliverable: Locator list and tests that use them
checks: Check each CSS selector in DevTools
No locators depend on layout position

days.topic: XPath Locators and Relative Locators
days.lab_task: Locate table cells, labels and buttons that have no IDs using XPath axes and text, and use relative locators to find a field next to its label.
days.deliverable: XPath locator list and tests
checks: Find the price in the row for a named product
Correct cell found with an axis
Field found next to its label

days.topic: Interacting with Elements: Forms, Buttons and Text
subtopics: Reading lists of elements with findElements
days.lab_task: Automate registration and login forms, read error messages for invalid input, count search results with findElements and check button states.
days.deliverable: Form tests and run output
checks: Submit registration with a bad email
isEnabled returns false before terms are accepted

days.topic: Dropdowns, Checkboxes, Radio Buttons and Tables
subtopics: Selecting by visible text, value and index
days.lab_task: Automate a filter page with a select dropdown, checkboxes and radio buttons, a custom JavaScript dropdown and a date picker, then read an order table into a list.
days.deliverable: Tests and extracted table data
checks: Select a category by visible text
Choose a date in the picker

days.topic: Synchronisation: Implicit, Explicit and Fluent Waits
subtopics: Waiting for visibility, clickability and text
days.lab_task: Fix a flaky test suite that uses Thread.sleep by replacing it with explicit waits for AJAX-loaded content and handle a stale element after a page refresh.
days.deliverable: Fixed tests and run output from 10 runs
checks: Refresh a list during a test

days.topic: Alerts, Frames and Multiple Windows
subtopics: iframes by index, name and element
Switching back to the main page
days.lab_task: Automate a page with an alert, a confirm and a prompt, an embedded payment iframe and a link that opens a new tab, returning to the main window each time.
days.deliverable: Tests and run output
checks: Page shows the right message for each
Fill a field inside the iframe
Switch to the new tab and back

days.topic: Mouse and Keyboard Actions and JavaScriptExecutor
subtopics: When JavaScript is the wrong answer
days.lab_task: Automate a hover menu, drag and drop items between lists, right-click a context menu and scroll to a lazy-loaded footer.
days.deliverable: Tests and run output
checks: Submenu becomes visible and is clicked
Item appears in the target list

days.topic: Screenshots, File Upload and File Download
subtopics: Download folder settings in Chrome options
days.lab_task: Upload a profile picture, download an invoice PDF and check it exists with the right name and size, and save a screenshot automatically when a test fails.
days.deliverable: Tests, downloaded file check and failure screenshot
checks: File exists with expected name and size above zero
Screenshot saved with the test name

days.topic: TestNG Essentials: Annotations, Assertions and Groups
days.lab_task: Organise the tests into a TestNG suite with set-up and tear-down methods, soft assertions for a product page, smoke and regression groups and a testng.xml file.
days.deliverable: TestNG suite and reports
checks: Both failures reported in one test
Browser opens and closes for each test

days.topic: Data-Driven Testing with DataProvider and Excel
days.lab_task: Run the login test for 15 users from an Excel sheet with expected results, add CSV data for search terms and report each row as its own test result.
days.deliverable: Data files, DataProvider code and report
checks: Add a new row to Excel
New case runs with no code change

days.topic: Page Object Model First Steps
subtopics: Locators and actions in page classes
days.lab_task: Refactor the login, search, product and cart tests into page objects with a base page class, and show that a changed locator is fixed in one place.
days.deliverable: Page object classes and refactored tests
checks: Fixed in one page class and all tests pass
Login returns the home page object

days.topic: Test Reports with ExtentReports and Logs
subtopics: Adding steps and screenshots to reports
days.lab_task: Add ExtentReports with steps and failure screenshots through a TestNG listener and Log4j2 logging, then share the report from a failed run.
days.deliverable: Report and log files
checks: Open the report after a failure
Each test has start, steps and end entries
Report summarises pass and fail counts

days.topic: Running Tests with Maven and Git
subtopics: Running suites and groups from the command line
days.lab_task: Run the suite from the command line with a browser parameter, push the project to GitHub with a .gitignore, and run it on a colleague's machine from a fresh clone.
days.deliverable: Repository and command-line run output
checks: Suite runs with no manual set-up
Reports and build output not committed
objectives: Run tests from the command line

days.topic: Debugging Failing Selenium Tests
days.lab_task: Debug ten planted failures in a provided suite, record the cause and fix for each and classify them as locator, timing, data or environment problems.
days.deliverable: Debug log and fixed suite
checks: Paused inside a failing test to inspect values

days.topic: Selenium IDE and When Not to Automate
days.lab_task: Record two flows in Selenium IDE, export them to Java and compare with hand-written tests, then build an automation backlog ranked by value and stability.
days.deliverable: Recorded tests, comparison and automation backlog
checks: Ranked by value, frequency and stability

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Automated Regression Suite for a Web Shop
subtopics: Page objects for the main pages
days.lab_task: Build a 30-test regression suite for the web shop with page objects, explicit waits, data-driven login and checkout tests, smoke and regression groups and ExtentReports, stored in Git, then demo a full run.
days.deliverable: Repository, report from a full run and a 10-minute demo
checks: Run the regression group three times
Break the checkout in the app
The right test fails with a screenshot
Page objects used and no Thread.sleep
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one suite

intermediate.summary: For automation engineers who write Selenium tests. Covers hybrid framework design, configuration and utilities, parallel execution, Selenium Grid 4 with Docker, cross-browser and cloud grids, CI with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, BDD with Cucumber, API and UI tests together, dynamic elements and shadow DOM, Selenium 4 features, flakiness control and Allure reporting.
prerequisites: Writes Selenium tests in Java with TestNG
Uses page objects and data-driven tests
outcomes: Design and build a maintainable hybrid automation framework
Run suites in parallel on Selenium Grid and cloud browsers
Run tests in CI with reports and quality gates
Combine UI, API and BDD tests and keep them stable

days.topic: Hybrid Framework Design
days.lab_task: Design and build the skeleton of a hybrid framework with layers, packages, naming rules and a README, and move the beginner suite into it.
days.deliverable: Framework skeleton, README and migrated tests
checks: Tests, pages, utilities and configuration separated
Follow the README on a fresh machine

days.topic: Driver Management with Factory and ThreadLocal
days.lab_task: Replace a static shared driver with a driver factory and ThreadLocal, support Chrome, Firefox and Edge locally and remotely, and prove drivers are cleaned up after failures.
days.deliverable: Driver factory and test evidence
checks: No test uses another test's browser
Tests run on a remote browser by configuration

days.topic: Configuration, Environments and Secrets
days.lab_task: Add configuration for three environments with Maven profiles, read secrets from environment variables, override values from the command line and fail fast on missing settings.
days.deliverable: Configuration files and run evidence
checks: Run against staging with a profile
Suite stops at start with a clear message

days.topic: Advanced Page Objects, Components and PageFactory
subtopics: Component objects for headers and tables
days.lab_task: Build reusable component objects for the header, product grid and data table, add fluent methods and a loadable component check, and compare PageFactory with plain By locators.
days.deliverable: Component classes, refactored tests and comparison notes
checks: Used on every page with no duplicate code
Open a page that loads slowly

days.topic: Utilities: Waits, Excel, Database and Email Helpers
subtopics: Database queries with JDBC for checks
days.lab_task: Write utilities for waits, data reading, database checks, random data and email, then automate a sign-up that confirms an emailed link and checks the database row.
days.deliverable: Utility classes, unit tests and sign-up test
checks: Email link opened and account active
New user row with the right status

days.topic: Parallel Execution with TestNG
days.lab_task: Run the suite in parallel by classes and by methods with four threads, fix the failures caused by shared state and measure the speed-up.
days.deliverable: Parallel configuration, fixes and timings
checks: Run in parallel with four threads
At least three times faster than serial

days.topic: Selenium Grid 4 with Docker
days.lab_task: Run Selenium Grid with Chrome, Firefox and Edge nodes in Docker Compose, run the suite against it in parallel with video recording and scale Chrome nodes to five.
days.deliverable: Compose file, run report and session videos
checks: Run the suite on the Grid

days.topic: Cross-Browser Testing and Cloud Grids
subtopics: Cloud grids: BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest
days.lab_task: Run the smoke suite on a cloud grid across six browser and OS combinations through a local tunnel, investigate a browser-specific failure and report it.
days.deliverable: Cloud run results and defect report

days.topic: Continuous Integration with Jenkins and GitHub Actions
subtopics: Grid in CI with service containers
days.lab_task: Run the smoke group on every pull request and the full regression nightly in Jenkins and GitHub Actions, publish reports and post results to a chat channel.
days.deliverable: Jenkinsfile, workflow file and run evidence
checks: Smoke tests run and report the status
Full regression runs and publishes the report

days.topic: BDD with Cucumber and Selenium
days.lab_task: Write feature files for search and checkout, implement step definitions on top of the page objects, tag smoke scenarios and produce Cucumber reports.
days.deliverable: Feature files, step definitions and reports
checks: Steps reuse page objects, no locators in step code

days.topic: Combining API and UI Tests with REST Assured
subtopics: When to use the API instead of the UI
Setting up test data through the API
Logging in through the API and reusing cookies
Checking UI actions through the API
days.lab_task: Create test users and products through the API, log in by injecting the session cookie, run a short UI check and verify the order through the API.
days.deliverable: Combined tests and timing comparison
checks: Set up data through the API
User and product exist before the UI test
Combined test faster than the full UI version

days.topic: Dynamic Elements, Shadow DOM and Complex Pages
days.lab_task: Automate a single-page app with dynamic IDs, a shadow DOM component, infinite scroll and short-lived toast messages, and write a request to developers for test IDs.
days.deliverable: Tests and a test ID request
checks: Interact with the shadow DOM component
Value set inside the shadow root

days.topic: Selenium 4 Features: CDP, BiDi and Network Control
days.lab_task: Use DevTools and BiDi to capture console errors, block analytics requests, simulate a slow 3G network and a location in Mumbai, and check the page behaves correctly.
days.deliverable: Tests and captured logs
checks: Errors collected and reported in the test
Requests blocked and page still works

days.topic: Cookies, Sessions and Authentication in Tests
days.lab_task: Test session expiry, logout and remember-me, reuse a logged-in session across tests through cookies and local storage, and run a two-user chat flow in two browsers.
days.deliverable: Session tests and run output
checks: User is sent to the login page
Test starts logged in without the login page
Message from one browser appears in the other

days.topic: Reducing Flakiness and Improving Stability
days.lab_task: Run the suite 30 times, rank flaky tests, fix the top five causes, add a retry analyser only for known infrastructure errors and track the flaky rate.
days.deliverable: Flakiness analysis, fixes and tracking
checks: Each passes 30 runs in a row

days.topic: Allure Reporting and Test Analytics
days.lab_task: Add Allure with steps, screenshots, Jira links and failure categories, publish history in CI and use the trend to find the least stable area.
days.deliverable: Allure configuration and published report
checks: Steps, screenshot and Jira link shown

days.topic: Testing Accessibility and Visuals with Selenium
subtopics: Handling dynamic content in visual tests
Where these checks fit in the suite
days.lab_task: Add axe accessibility checks to five pages, a keyboard-only navigation test and visual comparison for two pages with dynamic areas masked.
days.deliverable: Accessibility and visual tests with reports
checks: Checkout completed with the keyboard or blockers reported

days.topic: Mobile Web and a First Appium Test for Selenium Users
subtopics: Mobile browsers with Selenium and Chrome emulation
days.lab_task: Run the web shop tests on mobile Chrome emulation, then automate the native app's login with Appium using the same framework and page object style.
days.deliverable: Mobile web tests and Appium login test
checks: Tests pass on the mobile layout
Switch to the web view context

days.topic: Code Quality and Reviews for Test Automation
days.lab_task: Review a provided pull request of new tests against a checklist, fix static analysis warnings in the framework and refactor duplicate code.
days.deliverable: Review comments, fixes and refactoring diff
checks: Duplicate code removed with tests passing

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Hybrid Selenium Framework in CI
days.lab_task: Deliver a hybrid framework with driver factory, components, configuration, utilities, BDD and API-assisted tests, accessibility checks and parallel Grid runs in CI with Allure, then present it.
days.deliverable: Framework repository, pipeline, Allure report and a 15-minute demo
checks: Parallel Grid run finishes with the Allure report
The right tests fail with evidence
Flaky rate under the agreed limit
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one framework

advanced.summary: For senior automation engineers and test architects. Covers framework architecture at scale, design patterns, Selenium Grid on Kubernetes, suite performance and test impact analysis, observability for test runs, advanced network and browser control, security and compliance in automation, AI and self-healing, migration to and coexistence with Playwright, legacy suite rescue and leading automation teams.
prerequisites: Has built and maintained a Selenium framework in CI
Knows parallel runs, Grid and reporting
outcomes: Architect and scale Selenium automation for many teams
Run fast, observable and reliable suites on Kubernetes grids
Rescue, modernise and migrate legacy suites

days.topic: Automation Framework Architecture at Scale
days.lab_task: Split the framework into a versioned core library and team test projects, publish the core to a package registry, release a breaking change with a migration guide and record decisions.
days.deliverable: Core library, team project, release notes and decision records
checks: Tests pass after following the migration guide

days.topic: Design Patterns for Selenium Frameworks
days.lab_task: Apply builder, strategy and decorator patterns in the framework, add a WebDriver listener that logs every action, and build one flow in the screenplay pattern for comparison.
days.deliverable: Pattern implementations and comparison notes
checks: Use the builder for test data

days.topic: Selenium Grid on Kubernetes at Scale
days.lab_task: Deploy Selenium Grid on Kubernetes with Helm, autoscale Chrome nodes with KEDA from the session queue, run 200 parallel tests and report cost per run.
days.deliverable: Helm values, autoscaling evidence and cost report
checks: Nodes scale up and the queue drains

days.topic: Suite Performance and Test Impact Analysis
subtopics: Test impact analysis from code changes
days.lab_task: Cut a 90-minute suite to under 20 minutes using sharding, faster set-up and test impact analysis that runs only tests affected by a change.
days.deliverable: Timing analysis, changes and impact selection evidence
checks: Under 20 minutes for the full run
Selection still catches the planted defect

days.topic: Observability for Test Runs
subtopics: Logs, metrics and traces for tests
Sending test results to a time series database
Dashboards for pass rate, duration and flakiness
Linking test failures to application traces
days.lab_task: Send test results and timings to a time series database, build a Grafana dashboard for suite health, link a failing test to the application trace and alert on a pass rate drop.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, alert and trace link evidence
checks: Pass rate, duration and flaky rate per suite
Follow a failure to the trace

days.topic: Advanced Browser Control and Network Testing
subtopics: Mocking backend failures in UI tests
Authentication flows: SSO and MFA in tests
days.lab_task: Test how the UI handles backend errors, slow responses and offline mode with network mocking, capture HAR files and performance timings, and automate an SSO login in the test environment.
days.deliverable: Tests, HAR files and timing report
checks: Mock a 500 from the order API
Load and first paint times recorded
Logged in through the identity provider in the test environment

days.topic: Security and Compliance in Test Automation
subtopics: Personal data in test data and screenshots
tools: Vault or a cloud secret manager
days.lab_task: Move test secrets to a secret manager, mask personal data in screenshots and reports, scan the test project's dependencies and secure the Grid behind authentication.
days.deliverable: Security changes and scan report

days.topic: AI in Selenium Automation: Self-Healing and Test Generation
days.lab_task: Add self-healing locators with Healenium, change the UI and review the healed locators, generate tests for a new page with AI and fix them, and measure time saved.
days.deliverable: Healing report, reviewed AI tests and time comparison
checks: Change three locators in the app
Tests heal and the report lists new locators

days.topic: Selenium and Playwright Coexistence and Migration
subtopics: Comparing Selenium and Playwright in depth
When to migrate and when to stay
days.lab_task: Evaluate migration for a 600-test suite, migrate 30 tests to Playwright with shared reporting, run both in one pipeline and recommend a path.
days.deliverable: Evaluation, migrated tests, combined report and recommendation
checks: Run both suites in one pipeline

days.topic: Rescuing Legacy Selenium Suites
subtopics: Measuring health: pass rate, duration, flakiness
days.lab_task: Assess a provided legacy suite of 800 tests, delete or merge low-value tests, upgrade it to Selenium 4, stabilise the worst areas and show improved health metrics.
days.deliverable: Assessment, change log and before and after metrics
checks: Health metrics and problem areas reported
Pass rate up and duration down

days.topic: Testing Complex Enterprise Applications
subtopics: Testing SAP Fiori and Salesforce UIs
days.lab_task: Automate a lead-to-opportunity flow in a Salesforce developer org with dynamic components, set up data through the API and plan regression for a seasonal release.
days.deliverable: Automated flow, data set-up and release regression plan
checks: Set up data through the API
Records created before the UI test
Risk-based selection for the release notes

days.topic: Contributing to and Extending Selenium
days.lab_task: Write three custom ExpectedConditions and a wrapper that adds timing to every command, read driver logs to diagnose a failure and write an upstream-quality bug report.
days.deliverable: Custom code, diagnosis and bug report
checks: Root cause found in the logs

days.topic: Testing Single-Page Applications Built with React and Angular
subtopics: React state changes and the DOM
Combining UI tests with component tests
days.lab_task: Automate a React and an Angular demo app with stable waits for rendering, client-side routing and virtualised lists, and agree a test ID convention with the developers.
days.deliverable: Tests for both apps and the test ID convention
checks: URL and content checked without full reloads
Find an item in a virtualised list
Item scrolled into view and checked

days.topic: Test Data and Environments for Many Teams
days.lab_task: Build a small test data service that creates isolated users and orders per test run, add an environment health check before suites start and a dashboard of environment status.
days.deliverable: Test data service, health check and dashboard
checks: Run two teams' suites at once
Health check stops the suite with a clear reason

days.topic: Automation Metrics and Return on Investment
days.lab_task: Calculate the return on investment of the automation suite from effort and defect data, build an automation metrics dashboard and set goals for the next quarter.
days.deliverable: ROI model, dashboard and goals
checks: Based on stated effort and savings

days.topic: Leading Automation Teams
days.lab_task: Build a skills matrix and training plan for an automation team of eight, write coding standards and run a pairing session to onboard a new engineer.
days.deliverable: Skills matrix, training plan, standards and pairing notes

days.topic: Automation Strategy for Organisations
days.lab_task: Write an automation strategy for an organisation with 12 product teams covering the pyramid, tools, platform support, budget and a 12-month roadmap, and present it.
days.deliverable: Strategy document and presentation

days.topic: Testing in Regulated Environments with Selenium
subtopics: Traceability from requirements to automated tests
days.lab_task: Make the framework produce audit-ready evidence with requirement links, signed reports and retained artefacts, and pass a mock audit of one release.
days.deliverable: Evidence set-up and audit record
checks: Trace a requirement to its test run
Retrieve evidence for an old run

days.topic: Troubleshooting Large-Scale Automation Failures
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (a browser update breaking 200 tests, a Grid outage and corrupted test data), restore the pipeline and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Suite green with the browser version pinned or fixed
Write a runbook for data corruption

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Automation Platform with Selenium
days.lab_task: Deliver an automation platform with a versioned core framework, two team projects, an autoscaled Kubernetes Grid, test impact analysis, observability dashboards, self-healing and audit-ready evidence, then present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Platform repositories, dashboards, metrics and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Finishes within the time target with autoscaling
Only impacted tests run and catch the planted defect
ROI and strategy defended with data
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
